dataList.name: Paired Assault
dataList.desc: When an ally deals damage by striking an enemy, use the Skill 'Weakness Thrust' as an Unopposed Attack after the ally's attack ends (2 lần mỗi lượt)

dataList.name: Aiding Stab
dataList.desc: When an enemy attacks another ally, and if the allied unit has less than 25% HP after the attack, use the Skill 'Gia Xích Ngã Viện' as an Unopposed Attack lên kẻ tấn công (once per Encounter)

dataList.name: Siphoning Fulfillment
dataList.desc: Cuối Lượt: nhận 1 [DefenseUp] vào lượt kế for every 3 [Breath] on self (tối đa 6)

dataList.name: Morale Boost
dataList.desc: On Kill, hồi 10 SP for 2 Sinners with the least SP
